run_knn_ground_truth: run knn_ground_truth to compute exact k-NN results using a batched database iterator on CPU or GPU
create_synthetic_dataset: create a SyntheticDataset with specified dimension, train size, database size, and query count for testing FAISS indexes
run_big_batch_search: run big_batch_search to perform large-scale k-NN search with optional checkpointing and multi-threaded execution
run_two_level_clustering: run two_level_clustering to train a two-level K-means index and use it for IVF coarse quantizer training
run_merge_ondisk: run merge_ondisk to merge multiple on-disk IVF index shards into a single populated index
